q: Which provision would the OGRA (Amendment) Bill introduced in Pakistan's Senate on 30 October 2026 insert into the OGRA Ordinance, 2002?
e: The proposed new Section 8A concerns quarterly gas-cost reviews. The bill was introduced, not enacted. Sources: Senate of Pakistan; Dawn.

q: According to Reuters, coordinated dockworkers' strikes on 30 October 2026 extended to ports in how many countries?
e: Reuters reported action across 113 ports in 22 countries, with disruptions including Greek ferry services. Source: Reuters, 30 October 2026.

q: Which Pakistani military spokesman described Iran–US mediation as cautiously optimistic in a Reuters interview published on 30 October 2026?
o: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu
e: ISPR director-general Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry used the description; he did not announce a peace settlement.

q: What provisional annual headline CPI inflation rate did Destatis report for Germany in October 2026?
e: Germany's Federal Statistical Office estimated October CPI inflation at 2.8% year-on-year; 3.3% was September's rate and 2.1% October's core inflation.

q: Off which UAE emirate was the main GEM NO. 2 oil slick concentrated in the 30 October 2026 official update?
e: The UAE's official statement located the principal slick off Umm Al Quwain, with some pollution extending toward neighbouring northern emirates.
